title: Reply with text
summary: Flask: Reply with text. Change the message.
introduction: A route decorator connects GET / to a function. Its return value becomes the reply.

blocks.text: In a practice folder create a virtual environment and install Flask with python -m pip install flask. Save one example as app.py and run python app.py. Use http://127.0.0.1:8000.

blocks.title: Reply with text

blocks.text: The decorator registers the function under /. Returning text lets Flask build the response.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Keep the decorator directly above the function it belongs to.
